The DGID says SENTAX is its platform for online filing and payment (télépaiement) of taxes, mandatory for all declarations and payments of Large Enterprise Directorate taxpayers from 1 September 2026.
The DGID announces that taxpayers can now pay all taxes, duties, fees and charges through Orange's MAX IT mobile app, under the menu 'FAY SAMA IMPOT'.
The DGID's communique of 27 August 2026 says the SENTAX platform replaces ETAX for online payment (telepaiement) of taxes by Large Enterprises Directorate taxpayers.

DGID says foreign digital providers subject to the VAT under article 355 bis, in force from 1 July 2024, register remotely online and make VAT declarations through its Etax online platform, with no electronic payment channel stated.
Senegal's Ministry of Finance order has foreign digital suppliers file VAT returns online on the Etax platform and pay by bank transfer to the Treasurer General, effective 1 April 2024.
